Laurey 89101, Modern Cone Cabinet Knob in Satin Stainless Steel

The Satin Stainless Steel Cone Cabinet Knob is ideal for a modern kitchen remodel. Made out of stainless steel, the conical cabinet knob is as easy to care for as it is to install. This Modern Cone Cabinet Knob in Satin Stainless Steel comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Satin Stainless Cone Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
